description: Step 1 of voting. Emails a 6-digit code to the user's own address. Call it only when the user asked to vote for a specific nominee, gave their own email, and agreed to the voting rules (one vote per email per award, their email is used only to verify the vote; privacy: cofounderbase.com/awards/rules/). Pass consent true only after that yes. The code is never in this response: ask the user to read it from their inbox. Voting runs 16 December 2026 to 31 January 2027.

consent.description: true only after the user agreed to the voting rules.

email.description: The voter's own email address, typed by them.

nominee.description: The nominee: its slug from awards_search (for example "northwind-ai") or its website (for example northwind.ai).

name: awards_vote_start

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: Start a vote (sends a code)
